span.p: YES — a lookup matched, or the agent labelled it

color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
it is policy HL-2024-000811.
not a secret, and useful
in the record.

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
could be a policy number.
could be a citizen id.
could be a card number.

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
row stores:
masked = ••••••0811
digit_count = 10
digits = NULL

div.style: color: rgb(11, 37, 69) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
has anything said
WHAT these digits are?

div.style: color: rgb(8, 54, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: the agent's own screen always shows the real digits

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the inverted default (D44). Everywhere else in this codebase
the safe move is to store what happened. Here it is the opposite:
capture is UNTYPED, so an unidentified number is treated as
sensitive until something identifies it.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
what survives a restart is the FACT, not the value.
A capture of this length happened, these lookups ran, this was
their outcome. D44 asks for short retention and one-click
discard — a durable copy of an unknown number is the opposite
of both.

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
not the same question as the disclosure gate (D58).
mask() protects the LOG, never the agent. These are the caller's
own keystrokes, typed seconds ago, to the person they are
speaking to — hiding them deletes the feature and protects
nobody.
